description: Get a daily, weekly, or monthly Vedic horoscope, or a daily Western horoscope, for a zodiac sign. Western with advanced=true uses the advanced registered route. Unsupported Western weekly/monthly requests fail before any API call. Accepts English (aries-pisces) and Hindi (mesha-meena) sign names. Consult current Vedika API pricing before use.

advanced.description: Western only — include precision tropical positions.

period.description: Horoscope period. Default: daily. Western currently supports daily only.

system.description: vedic=sidereal Moon sign (default). western=tropical Sun sign.

name: vedika_horoscope
